newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct trade deficit seen at $900 mln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct trade deficit seen at $900 mln - paper.

text.p: Brazil is likely to post a trade deficit of at least $900 million in October, the Folha de Sao Paulo daily said on Wednesday.

The newspaper said the disappointing performance of Brazil's exports last month led government officials to revise their estimates for October's deficit. Previously, the government expected a $800 million trade gap, it said.
The Industry and Commerce Ministry said on Tuesday exports totalled $4.188 billion last month, up from $4.115 billion in September but down from $4.405 billion in October 1995.
